pieces.Text: After the first round of combat, a gloomwing can emit a strange, musky scent in a 30-foot radius as a free action.  All creatures within this area (save for other gloomwings or tenebrous worms) must make a DC

Fortitude save each round to avoid becoming weakened by the pheromones.  Once a creature fails a save against this effect, it takes a -4 penalty to its Strength score - this penalty lasts for as long as the battle continues and for 1 hour thereafter.  Lesser restoration or any other effect capable of healing ability damage immediately removes this Strength penalty.
